Career Area: 
  
 
 
 Job Description: 
 
 Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. 
 
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other.  We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
 
 About Cat Financial 
 Cat Financial is a subsidiary of Caterpillar Inc., the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For more than 40 years, Cat Financial has provided a wide range of financing solutions to customers and Cat® dealers for machines, engines, Solar® gas turbines, genuine Cat parts and services. Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, Cat Financial serves customers globally with offices and subsidiaries located throughout North and South America, Asia, Australia, Europe and Africa. Visit cat.com to learn more about Cat Financial.

 Team Mission
 Give Cat Financial one governed platform where work moves from idea to delivery, and where AI agents and automation take on the repetitive work so our people can focus on decisions.

 Artemis is Caterpillar Financial's IT delivery platform, supporting work from demand intake through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support. The platform provides common workflows, milestones, and tools that help teams work more consistently, efficiently, and effectively across the delivery lifecycle. Artemis is also a key enabler of Cat Financial's AI transformation strategy, embedding AI-powered capabilities into the way teams plan, deliver, and support technology solutions.

 About the Role
 Lead the design, development, and delivery of new capabilities for the Artemis platform, leveraging full stack engineering and AI technologies to transform ideas into scalable, production-ready solutions. This role partners closely with technical and business stakeholders to solve complex challenges, establish engineering best practices, drive modern software delivery through CI/CD, and ensure AI-enabled capabilities are secure, reliable, and compliant. As a senior technical leader, you will influence the platform's architecture, mentor development teams, and help shape the future of one of Caterpillar Financial's most visible technology transformation initiatives.
 
 Key Responsibilities
 Lead proof-of-concept and development work for new capabilities, and partner with the Team Leader and development team to take them into production
 Design and build full stack features across React/TypeScript front ends, Python or Node.js services and APIs, and AWS cloud services
 Drive UI/UX and front-end architecture decisions so Artemis stays intuitive, consistent, and easy to use as it grows
 Build AI-enabled capabilities and agent-based workflows, including prompt and context design, evaluation, and guardrails that keep them safe and reliable
 Design and build integrations with enterprise systems such as Snowflake, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, and GitHub
 Establish reusable patterns, coding standards, and shared components for the platform
 Write and maintain automated tests, and help build the test coverage and pipeline practices that move the team toward CI/CD
 Support production deployments, and provide production support as needed: troubleshoot complex issues, lead root-cause analysis, and drive lasting fixes
 Review pull requests in GitHub and mentor developers, reducing key-person dependency and building depth across the team
 Work with architecture and security partners to test emerging technologies, guide their implementation, and ensure solutions meet Cat Financial's standards and audit requirements
 Demo new capabilities to stakeholders and turn their feedback into clear technical next steps
 
 What You Bring
 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including building and supporting production applications
 Strong front-end experience with React and TypeScript
 Strong back-end experience building services and APIs in Python or Node.js
 Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services (for example serverless compute, API management, storage, and managed AI services)
 Experience building integrations with enterprise systems (for example Snowflake, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, GitHub)
 Experience working with relational databases and REST APIs
 Proficiency with GitHub-based workflows, including branching, pull requests, and code review
 Hands-on experience building applications with generative AI, such as working with large language models, agent-based workflows, retrieval, and evaluation
 A track record of turning prototypes into production-ready, maintainable solutions
 Experience writing automated tests and supporting release and deployment processes
 Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work through ambiguous problems
 Clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences
 
 Top candidates will have
 Experience delivering AI agents or LLM-based solutions in production
 Experience in financial services or other regulated industries (SOX, audit, IT risk)
 Experience setting architecture patterns, coding standards, or reusable components for a team or platform
 Experience mentoring developers or serving as technical lead for a development team
 Experience building automated test suites and CI/CD pipelines
 Experience designing component libraries or shared UI frameworks
 Understanding of secure application development practices
 Experience with workflow, low-code, or process automation platforms
 Experience with Agile delivery and Azure DevOps
 
 What Success Looks Like
 Proofs of concept are proven quickly and delivered to production with the team
 Established patterns and standards are adopted across the platform
 AI capabilities deliver measurable improvements to delivery workflows
 Automated test coverage grows, moving the team closer to CI/CD
 Platform knowledge is shared, reducing key-person dependency
 
 Degree Requirement
 A bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, a related discipline, or equivalent experience is required.
 
 Compensation & Benefits:   
 Summary Pay Range:   $118,860.00 - $190,176.00 
   
 Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job-related knowledge, skills, individual performance, and experience. Please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Caterpillar.  

 Benefits:   
 Subject to plan eligibility, terms, and guidelines. This is a summary of the benefits. 
  Medical, dental, and vision benefits* 
 Paid time off plan (Vacation, Holidays, Volunteer, etc.) * 
 401(k) savings plans* 
 Health Savings Account (HSA)* 
 Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)* 
 Health Lifestyle Programs* 
 Employee Assistance Program* 
 Voluntary Benefits and Employee Discounts* 
 Career Development* 
 Incentive bonus* 
 Disability benefits 
 Life Insurance 
 Parental leave 
 Adoption benefits 
 Tuition Reimbursement    
 * These benefits also apply to part-time employees  

  
  
 
This position requires working onsite five days a week.  
  
 
Relocation is available for this position.  
  
 
Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. 
 Posting Dates: 
October 1, 2026 - October 8, 2026 
 Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen.     
 
 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer, Including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities.  Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply.
